title: senecio pinnatus var. leptolobus
intro: Senecio pinnatus var. leptolobus, commonly known as the Narrow-leaved Jacob's Ladder or Woolly Senecio, is a plant species native to the western United States and Canada. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Senecio pinnatus var. leptolobus are attributed to its ability to act as a bronchodilator, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
